categories.name: Baggage / Pack expecting complications
items: Medicines and medical devices (including corrective eyewear)
Clothing you need before you can reach a shop (especially if going to a climate where what you are wearing isn't adequate)

categories.name: Get around / Navigation
items: a compass , especially if you're going someplace without a grid of city streets

categories.name: Wear / Laundering clothes
items: a universal sink stopper , and you can do your washing in your bathroom sink if necessary

categories.name: See and do / Power supplies
items: battery chargers and travel power adapters for any electrical device you may use

categories.name: See and do / Photography and videos
items: a camera , along with sufficient storage and batteries

categories.name: See and do / Time fillers
items: some amusements for long waits and journeys
cheap corded headphones instead of expensive and easily-lost wireless headphones
a pack of cards for when the batteries are dead, and all else fails

categories.name: Other
items: A utility knife for outdoor life

categories.name: Connect
items: along a laptop or tablet to get online
a plug adapter if you need one
